description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'IndexTidDepth' for handling taxonomy term arguments with depth filtering in Views. It includes methods for constructing the plugin, defining options, building form elements, customizing query behavior, and generating titles based on taxonomy terms.

classes.name: IndexTidDepth
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for handling taxonomy term arguments with depth filtering in Views.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the plugin with configuration, ID, definition, and entity repository.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the plugin, including depth, break_phrase, and use_taxonomy_term_path.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for configuring plugin options, including depth and break phrase settings.

methods.name: defaultActions
methods.description: Overrides defaultActions to remove certain summary actions from the available options.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds the query based on the argument, handling break phrase logic and adding subquery joins.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Generates a title for the argument based on the taxonomy term's label.
